version: LOCK 49 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - the finale, the hard year: the hoarders and the bread lines
builds_on: LOCK 9 Salma's oven and meals, LOCK 34 runner, LOCK 48 (chapter 4 done). Design reference (not shown): Muslim 1605 (no one hoards but a sinner).

missions.title: The hoarders
missions.button: Jalal the grain merchant wants a word

a.text: No rain since autumn and bread costs three times what it did. Jalal the grain merchant has three storehouses full and is waiting for prices to climb further. He offers you a share: buy grain now and sell it in a month.

qadi.text: Qadi Ibrahim orders Jalal's storehouses opened and the grain sold at last year's price. Jalal doesn't speak to you again.

buy.text: Jalal writes your name in his book. “A month,” he says. “You'll double it.”

exposed: Told the qadi about Jalal's grain

a.text: Jalal counts out sixty coins. Behind him there is a bread line round the square.

choices.label: Give it all to Salma's oven

took.text: Word gets around fast in a hungry town.

gave.text: Salma bakes through the night with the flour it buys.

profited: Got rich on the hungry year
gave: Gave the hoard money to the oven

missions.title: The bread lines
missions.kicker: The hard year · The bread lines
missions.button: The bread line reaches the square

a.text: The bread line stretches round the square. Salma's oven runs day and night, and her flour is nearly gone. People are pushing.

choices.label: Buy flour for Salma's oven · 40 coins
Stand in the line and keep order
Push to the front for your own bread

flour.text: Four sacks of flour arrive by cart. Salma doesn't stop working, but she nods at you over the oven.

order.text: You walk the line, helping the old ones to the front and calming the shouting. By sunset everyone in the line has eaten.

self.text: You get your loaf. An old woman behind you doesn't.

flour: Bought flour for the bread line
